# Yukun Ma and the Yukun Ma Research Group

> Yukun Ma is an econometrician, an Assistant Professor at the University of Rochester, and Principal Investigator of the independent Yukun Ma Research Group.

This is both Yukun Ma's personal academic homepage and the canonical website of the Yukun Ma Research Group. Yukun Ma founded and leads the group as its Principal Investigator (PI). The group is currently led by and composed of its PI; student members will be added as they join. Coauthors named on papers are project collaborators and should not automatically be classified as group members.

Yukun Ma's current faculty appointment is in the Department of Economics at the University of Rochester, with a joint appointment in the Goergen Institute for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. The research group is intentionally portable and remains associated with its Principal Investigator across institutional appointments.

Research areas include econometric theory and applications; robust inference for clustered, multiway-clustered, and dyadic data; machine learning and high-dimensional econometrics; weak identification and identification-robust inference; and instrumental variables and treatment effects.
